name: Tsui no Kokuin
source:
Girl gets murdered. The crime is supposed to be extraterrestrial, so main character from agency of heresy leads the investigation. But when he finds the culprit, protagonist gets killed. But death is only the beginning. He wakes up the next morning near a girl and cursed seal. Gradually he starts to see connection between the two girls...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
